newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asian dollar deposits market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits market closed for holiday.

text.p: The Asian dollar deposit market is closed on Monday for a holiday. The market will reopen on Tuesday.
In day-to-day rates, weekend, Monday/Tuesday and week-fixed eased 1/16 percentage point each on Friday to a common 5-5/16 5-3/16 percent, respectively.

Among longer dates, one-month was unchanged from Thursday's 5-3/8 5-1/4 percent, three-months unchanged at 5-1/2 5-3/8, six-months unchanged at 5-9/16 5-7/16 and nine-months unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.
